concepts.def: Freely moving joint with fluid-filled capsule.
Joint with widest range — shoulder, hip.
Smooth tissue covering bone ends inside joints.
Tough band of tissue joining bone to bone.
Tough band joining muscle to bone.

walkthroughs.body_html: Synovial joints contain a capsule filled with synovial fluid (lubrication), with cartilage on bone ends to reduce friction. Ligaments stabilise the joint; tendons attach the muscles that move it.
Six synovial joints: ball-and-socket (shoulder, hip), hinge (knee, elbow), pivot (neck), condyloid (wrist), saddle (thumb), gliding (carpals between wrist bones).
Shooting a netball — shoulder ball-and-socket flexion + elbow hinge extension. Heading a football — neck pivot rotation. Tennis serve — full kinetic chain using shoulder, elbow and wrist joints.
